content: Hello, this is Alex from Amazon Customer Support. Am I speaking with the account holder for the recent order placed last week?
Hi, um, yes, I ordered some textbooks for college. Is there a problem?
Thank you for confirming. I wanted to let you know that your order is currently on hold due to a minor issue with customs clearance. Don't worry, this can be resolved smoothly.
Wait, customs clearance? I just ordered from Amazon like normal.

Absolutely, and in most cases, orders ship without any issue. However, sometimes with certain items or first-time accounts, our system flags a regulatory compliance check. It's a standard Amazon policy, especially for student accounts. May I confirm your full name and the email linked to your Amazon account, please?
Sure, it's Jamie Chen, and the email is chenjamie1999@gmail.com.
Thank you, Jamie. To verify, could you provide the phone number associated with the account? This ensures your privacy and helps us update your order status.

Thanks! Now, looking at your account, I see that the customs team requires a temporary regulatory fee before your textbooks can be released. This is a refundable charge and is part of enhanced security for new users. I want to assure you this is a standard Amazon protocol.
Oh, I didn't know about that. How much is it?
It's a $98 regulatory hold. Once you pay, your books will ship, and the fee returns to your account within 1-2 business days. I'm here to guide you through the process so it's quick and easy.
Okay, so how do I pay that? Can I just use my card on Amazon?

Our compliance department processes these holds separately from regular payments. For speed and security, we use Amazon Gift Cards to process the fee. Do you have access to a local store or can you purchase a gift card online?
Yeah, I can get one at the campus bookstore. Does it have to be an Amazon card?
Yes, that's perfect. Please purchase an Amazon Gift Card totaling $98. Once you have it, I'll walk you through how to provide the code securely for processing.
Alright, I'll go grab one now. Will my order ship right away after this?
Yes, as soon as we confirm the regulatory hold, your order is prioritized for shipping. I'll also send you a confirmation email. Let me know when you have the gift card handy.
Okay, I have the card now. What do I do with it?
Great! Please carefully scratch off the silver strip to reveal the claim code. For security, type the entire code here so I can submit it to our compliance team.
Alright, the code is AX7P-1234-5678-90BC.
Thank you. I'm processing this now. While I wait for confirmation, could you confirm your shipping address so I can update the delivery status?
Sure, it's 12 Maple Avenue, Room 204, Springfield, 54321.

Perfect, thank you. I see the verification is underway. Sometimes there may be a secondary fee if your account is flagged as shared, for example, if multiple users access the same device. Has anyone else logged into your Amazon account recently?
Yeah, my roommate helped make the account. Is that a problem?

It's nothing to worry about, but Amazon's policy may require a brief additional verification. If there is a secondary hold, it's usually $49 and is processed the same way. I'll let you know if that's the case.
Okay, just let me know. I really need those books for class.
Absolutely. We'll make sure you receive your order without further delay. If there's anything else you need, please ask, I'm here to help.
